name: Aman Nagpal
bio: Aman Nagpal is an entrepreneur, marketing consultant, and founder of Get Marketed, Get BWG, and Get Assured. Specialising in F&B and hospitality marketing, he leads a team of 40+ marketing professionals helping restaurants, cafés, bars, and hotels build strong brands. With experience working with 250+ brands, he focuses on strategic branding, digital marketing, and driving measurable business growth.

name: Sparsha Jain
bio: Sparsha is a branding and marketing consultant, digital creator, and creative strategist specialising in fashion, lifestyle, F&B, and user-generated content (UGC). With a passion for storytelling, brand building, and creative expression, she helps brands connect with audiences through engaging content and innovative marketing strategies. She is also a dancer and model.

name: MS Chang
bio: Nikha Rathore (Ms. Chang) is an award-winning Latin artist, Bachata and Kizomba dancer, and founder of Social Dance Tribe. Recognised as Artist of the Year by ApariTV, she is passionate about promoting Latin dance culture, artistic expression, and building a vibrant social dancing community in Jaipu.r

name: Dipen Singh
bio: Dipen Singh is an educator, entrepreneur, and founder of ArrivEd, a podcast exploring business, science, and life. He serves as Deputy Director at St. Edmund’s School, Jaipur, where he focuses on educational innovation, strategy, and teacher development. Passionate about reimagining education, he is also building a future-focused school that encourages curiosity, independent thinking, and real-world learning.

name: Ankit Dhir
bio: Ankit Dhir is the Founder and CEO of Habilelabs, a technology company specialising in scalable digital solutions. An IIT Bombay and Washington University alumnus, he is an AI strategist, Guinness World Record holder, and Generative AI and automation advisor with over 15 years of experience driving innovation and business growth.

name: Tejasvi Chandela
bio: Chef Tejasvi Chandela is an award-winning pastry chef and entrepreneur, recognised for her creativity and contribution to the culinary industry. She was named Young Pastry Chef 2023 by Central Travel and Tourism Research Association (CTTRA) and received the Pastry Talent Award 2023 at La Liste. She is the founder of Dzurt, a renowned patisserie brand with a presence in Jaipur and Gurgaon, known for its artisanal desserts and innovative approach to pastry. Through her work, Chef Tejasvi continues to bring creativity and excellence to the world of patisserie.

name: Sahil Garg
bio: Sahil Garg is the founder and entrepreneur behind Petit Paris Jaipur, a patisserie brand. A professional pastry chef, he specializes in eggless baking and creates a variety of gourmet desserts, cakes, and confectionery. Through his baking expertise and online sessions, he shares his passion for pastry-making with a wider audience.

name: Genius Jain
bio: Genius Jain is an entrepreneur and the founder of **Midori India**, with a passion for hospitality, marketing, and brand building. He combines creativity with business insights to build memorable food experiences and shares practical learnings from his entrepreneurial journey.

name: Abhishek Khandelwal
bio: After gaining experience in consulting and industry and working with global corporations, Abhishek has acquired Moustache Hostel and expended the business from 1 hostel to 11 hostel in 2 years with a view to create a large chain of hostels.

name: CA Anand Jain
bio: Chartered Accountant and seasoned entrepreneur with over 8 years of experience in building scalable, customer-centric business models in the QSR and retail sectors.

name: Akshay Kedia
bio: He has been an entrepreneur for 14 years, mainly working in Branding, Design and Advertising, aditionaly owning one FNB brand focusing as quick-service restaurants for the last 8 years.

name: Samyak Jain
bio: He is the numbers whiz with a heart full of coffee who brews up success with a smile. The backbone of Crazy Coffee's financial health.
